name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. Accurately describes behavior: closes a chapter-intro/menu dialog panel with a 5-frame slide-down (slide-out) animation, restores the framebuffer snapshot, and frees the three dialog workspace buffers. No address-residue suffix; the trailing token 'slide_out' is semantic, not a hex address.
purpose: Close a chapter-intro / menu dialog panel: play a 5-frame slide-down animation, restore the underlying mode-13h framebuffer from a backup snapshot, then free the three 64000-byte dialog workspace buffers.
logic_summary: Compiler-injected __CHK(0x14) stack-probe prologue (not source). Loop frame_iter = 1..5 calls fd2_slide_panel_down_step(frame_iter*0xD + 0x70, accumulator_buf, composed_target_buf), giving panel_y = 0x7D,0x8A,0x97,0xA4,0xB1. Then memmove(0xA0000, bg_snapshot_buf, 64000) restores the saved screen to VRAM, followed by free() of the three workspaces (accumulator, bg_snapshot, composed_target). Unlike the in-battle sibling fd2_close_status_screen_with_slide_out @ 0x196CB, this variant does NOT recomposite a battle frame afterward.
reads_globals: data_fd2_ui_slide_anim_accumulator_buf_ptr @ 0x53C5B (per-frame animation accumulator buffer pointer; passed to slide step, then freed)
data_fd2_ui_slide_bg_snapshot_buf_ptr @ 0x53C5F (framebuffer backup snapshot pointer; memmove source to restore VRAM, then freed)
data_fd2_ui_slide_composed_target_buf_ptr @ 0x53C63 (composed dialog-panel target image pointer; passed to slide step, then freed)
notes: Source comment block, Ghidra plate, and decompile are mutually consistent and accurate; nothing changed in src or plate.
